note: CodeWarrior Pro 7 (2001) for Mac OS 8.6 and 9 (needs CarbonLib 1.3.1+: the tools layers have 1.6): Install CodeWarrior 7.0 from the 7.1 Tools CD, Easy Install (C, C++, Java) into the target, registration left for later; the CD's 7.1 update onto it; then the 7.2 PowerPC compiler and linker plugins over 7.1's (the update's INTO folders, by file: COPY replace). The installers quit every other application (BridgeAgent too) and restart: the guest restarts and the launcher brings the agent back. Install Location's value is drawn by PowerPC code the text feed doesn't see: the popup is pressed beside its label (offset). First launch done: "Where is Mac OS X?" (for Mach-O targets) answered Continue, so the preferences are captured.
